html:
SMTO-CTX-0029 — Your saved messages don't all fit in the model

GUID: 36b51bc2-68fa-480b-b4bc-fdbd1a543134
Slug: saved-task-context-exceeds-capacity
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: context

What happened

  • You saved some messages to keep with this task. Together with the task's own instructions they're too long for the model, so SMTO stopped before sending anything. Your saved messages weren't cut or changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Under the task, open Saved task context and select Remove next to each message you no longer need. SMTO always sends saved messages in full, so saving fewer is how to make room.
  2. Continue the task, for example by selecting Resume if it's shown. Nothing was sent to the model before, so continuing with the smaller selection doesn't repeat any work.
  3. If you need every saved message, choose a model that can hold more text as Main in Settings › Setup › Model routing, then start a new task. Typing a bigger number into settings doesn't add room; only a model that really holds more does.

What success looks like

  • In Saved task context your saved messages show Included in model input and the task continues.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete the original messages from the conversation to make room; removing them from Saved task context is enough.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Context preparation stopped before inference because the required task instructions, essential handoff and full text of saved task-context messages exceed the model context after optional history was reduced; saved selections and operation receipts are unchanged.

What this means

  • The required task instructions, essential handoff and full saved messages do not fit in the current model context after optional history is reduced. No inference request was sent. Saved selections and operation receipts remain intact.

Why this can happen

  • Full saved message bodies plus protected instructions and continuation state exceed the available input budget.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect saved_message_ids, source availability and the context preparation status.

How to fix it

  • Remove saved-message selections in the Saved task context panel (the DELETE route under the task's task-context/saved-messages API) or route to a model with genuinely larger served context, then continue. Saved text is never truncated, and raising context_window_tokens cannot add served capacity.
  • Open Saved task context and remove selections you no longer need, or apply a supported context-capacity change, then Continue. A configuration number cannot increase the capacity served by the model.

Retry and execution caution

  • The required permitted context can be included in full.

How to verify the fix

  • Inspect submitted context source identities.

What not to do

  • Do not silently truncate saved text or restore deleted content.

Technical notes

  • Saving and removal do not wake or restart the task.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-CTX-0005 — Your request and the model's answer won't fit together
